name: qb-studio
description: A localhost-only Windows workbench for Cfx.re server-resource coding.
author: QBCore Framework

scripts.predev:electron: npm run prepare:luals && npm run build:runtime
scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node --test dist-electron/pathSafety.test.js dist-electron/resourceContext.test.js dist-electron/revertStore.test.js dist-electron/workspaceSearch.test.js dist-electron/manifestModel.test.js dist-electron/dependencyGraph.test.js dist-electron/resourceCompare.test.js dist-electron/resourceDuplicate.test.js dist-electron/resourceImport.test.js dist-electron/portPreflight.test.js dist-electron/bookmarkStore.test.js dist-electron/crashTriage.test.js dist-electron/windowState.test.js dist-electron/recentWorkspaces.test.js dist-electron/whatsNew.test.js dist-electron/clientInstallDiscovery.test.js dist-electron/localUrl.test.js dist-electron/appUpdate.test.js dist-electron/toolApproval.test.js dist-electron/projectTools.test.js dist-electron/fsTree.test.js dist-electron/githubClient.test.js dist-electron/managedRuntime.test.js dist-electron/operationLock.test.js dist-electron/workspaceCreator.test.js dist-electron/windowEmbedValidation.test.js dist-electron/serverArtifacts.test.js dist-electron/configStore.test.js dist-electron/luaLanguageServer.test.js
scripts.predist: npm run prepare:luals && npm run build
